name: Limited System Activity Template
description: Exposes a restricted slice of Looker System Activity explores with enforced performance limits and user ID access constraints.

explores.description: List of system__activity explores allowed for this workflow and their configurations

name.description: Name of the explore in system__activity (e.g. 'history', 'dashboard', 'user')

allow_csv_export.description: Whether to allow exporting query results to CSV for this explore (default: false)

required_filter_fields.description: List of specific field(s) required to be filtered before query execution (e.g. ['history.created_time'])

max_row_limit.description: Performance preset enforcing a maximum row limit cap for queries

user_id_limitation.description: Limitation enforcing filtering queries by user ID

mode.description: 'self' (default) filters to the invoking user's ID; 'scope_groups' filters to user IDs in scope groups where configured user attribute is 'yes'; 'none' applies no user ID filtering

attribute_name.description: User attribute name set on groups for scope group matching (default: 'nano_admin_is_workflow_scope_group')
